_comment: codebase-to-domain-doc: reads the Tools and ListingSyncer codebases READ-ONLY (codebase writes are explicitly denied here because the root settings allow them for jira-to-pr) and writes only to products/*/working/. MCP permission rules do not support glob wildcards — 'mcp__*' matches nothing; 'mcp__atlassian' allows the whole server. Jira write tools are denied because this pipeline never touches Jira. Confluence create/update is used only by the confluence-publisher subagent behind the mandatory Gate D.
